caveats: Hospitals with an emergency department and fire stations come from the pipeline's lists. Dialysis, nursing homes, urgent care, police and pharmacies come from federal / HHS facility lists (dated per entry), topped up with OpenStreetMap; EMS stations and other hospitals are OpenStreetMap only.
Lists are incomplete and can be out of date: a place may have closed, moved or changed hours. A listing is not a statement that it is open, staffed or reachable. Call ahead; call 911 in an emergency.
No shelter list: no official inventory is in the pipeline.
